meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Morning, everyone. Thanks for coming in early. This is the kickoff for ClinicLink, the patient booking app for our outpatient clinics.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: Morning. I brought chai, it's on the side table.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: You're a hero, Kiran.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Let's go through the big choices today so Ravi's team can start next week. First, reminders. Our no-show rate at Andheri is around eighteen percent.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: Some days it's worse. Mondays are terrible.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Dr. Mehta
meeting_transcripts.content: A reminder helps a lot. At my old hospital we sent an SMS two days before, and no-shows dropped by almost a third.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: SMS is easy for us. We already have a bulk SMS account for the lab reports.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Two days before gives people time to reschedule instead of just not turning up.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: And patients do read SMS. Not everyone has a smartphone.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Okay, so appointment reminders go out by SMS, two days before the appointment. Agreed?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Dr. Mehta
meeting_transcripts.content: Agreed.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Fine by me.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Next, where and when we launch.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Andheri is the obvious pilot. Their front desk already uses the new schedule screens.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: And the Andheri manager is keen. She asked me twice last week.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Ravi, is the first of March realistic?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: If we don't add anything big, yes. Tight, but doable.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Then the app launches at the Andheri clinic on the first of March.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll tell the Andheri team today.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Payments. Sofia, over to you.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Sofia
meeting_transcripts.content: For online payments I'd go with Razorpay. Our finance system already reconciles their settlement reports, and their compliance paperwork is done.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Their SDK is fine. I've used it before.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Any objections? No? Online payments go through Razorpay, then.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Sofia
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll send Ravi the keys for the test account.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: How far ahead can patients book?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Dr. Mehta
meeting_transcripts.content: Not too far, please. Doctors' leave plans change, and then the front desk has to cancel people.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: A month is what we do on the phone today.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: So patients can book up to thirty days ahead.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Thirty days, noted.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Languages.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: Hindi, definitely. Half our patients at Andheri prefer it.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: English and Hindi is fine. Every extra language means more testing.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: The app supports English and Hindi at launch.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Dr. Mehta
meeting_transcripts.content: Can I raise video consultations? Some of my colleagues keep asking about them.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Video is a whole project. Recording, consent, a stable connection on patients' phones...

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Dr. Mehta
meeting_transcripts.content: Honestly, I agree. Not for the first version.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Then video consultations are out of scope for version one.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: One idea from the front desk: loyalty points for regular patients? People keep asking about discounts.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Sofia
meeting_transcripts.content: That needs a proper look on the finance side. Let's not decide it now.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Agreed, we park the loyalty idea.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Can someone get me the slot data this week?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll ask the Andheri manager.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Good. Same time next week. Thanks, all.
